title: Food Delivery Time Prediction
summary: A Flask web application that estimates food delivery time from delivery-person inputs and geocoded restaurant/delivery locations using a serialized machine-learning model.
capabilities_verified_in_source: Loads a serialized model from model.pkl
Uses OpenCage API to geocode restaurant and delivery locations
Returns estimated delivery time in minutes
important_limitations: Several encoded feature values (including traffic, order type, vehicle, festival and city categories) are hardcoded in the inspected app.py.
Do not claim all conditions are dynamically captured.
